context.focus: Use dated source evidence to define the ideal customer, buying trigger, alternatives, category, differentiated value, objections, truthful claims, search intents, distribution hypotheses, and measurement goals.
forbidden_scope: deleting or replacing prior architecture artifacts
design work before workflow contracts pass
invented market demand, search volume, customers, reviews, rankings, backlinks, citations, or performance
mass-generated public pages or keyword permutations

definition_of_done: product_brief.organic_discovery uses product_factory.organic_discovery.v1 and research_status is researched.
The positioning names one ideal customer, job to be done, buying trigger, primary alternative, value proposition, at least two differentiators, and at least two objections.
At least two dated evidence sources retain a source ref, source type, and observed insight.
Every approved customer-facing claim resolves to retained evidence; unsupported ideas remain hypotheses or prohibited.
Query clusters group real customer language by intent and map to proposed public routes rather than keyword permutations.
Distribution pursues legitimate channels and earned evidence while forbidding fabricated reviews, link schemes, and inauthentic mentions.
Measurement prioritizes qualified conversion and commercial outcomes over rankings or raw traffic.

After the owned section passes, append or update agent_evidence for market_positioning_research_agent with status done, at least one scoped check in checks_passed, and an empty checks_failed list. Unfinished downstream stages are dependencies, not failures of this task.
